FK TSC, commonly known as TSC, is a Serbian professional football club based in Bačka Topola. Its initial founding date in 1913 as Topolyai Sport Club makes it currently the second-oldest football club in the Serbian First League, although the club dissolved in 2003 and was reformed under its current incarnation in 2005.
